# Change email
{: .no_toc }

Start an email change; the new address must be verified.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ACC-02` |
| **Route** | `/account/email` · deep link `substratal://account/email` |
| **Where** | Personal › Account |
| **Who can use it** | Self |
| **Kind** | form |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| New email | email-field | body.email | required; differs from current | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=email |
| Save | primary-button | PATCH /users/me |  | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Save | `PATCH /users/me {email}` | 200 → User.pending_email set; show AUTH-04-style "check your new inbox". 409 not_unique → "That email is already in use." |
